title: Prove the sharp partial-axis root-code floor (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

A scoped all-size proof settles the intermediate-axis punctures left open by ywz65's #2582. Keep every signed edge line and any k coordinate-axis lines in dimension n>=4. Over any coefficient field of characteristic other than two, every finite exact root-code Gram factorization has dense binary support-rank cost at least n(n-1)+k. Coordinate factors attain it, and every optimum has exactly n nonzero terms.

```text
all signed edges + k retained axes
  exact coefficient identity on the retained k coordinates
  at least k terms contain two complete axis stars
  signed-edge tariff + retained-axis charge
  exact minimum n(n-1)+k = retained line count
```

The new case is 0<k<n. ywz65's #2582/#2719 already settle the endpoints and supply the cited cross-star and Dn lemmas. DreamingOfClouds retains the #2228/#2277 root-code and one-extra coupling credit; Aaron Wang retains #2272/#2518's root generators/screens, and ywz65 retains #2536's different coordinate/pairing result. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

- Before: the arbitrary-axis puncture family had no all-term floor in the cited packages. After: `research/axis-punctured-root-code-floor/PROOF.md` supplies the retained-axis rank argument and all finite term-count cases.
- Standalone exact replay reports `PASS_AXIS_PUNCTURED_ROOT_CODE_FLOOR`: 802,334 support pairs, 314 coordinate attainments, 125 rational expansions, 58,625 count inequalities and eight controls. The complete finite support domains are all intermediate axis masks and projective-vector pairs over F3 at n=4,5 and F5 at n=4. The written proof supplies the universal quantifiers.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized registered commands pass locally in about five seconds each, 10.38 seconds together. The direct verifier, metadata/pins, seven-file committed-byte/source-history preflight and committed export integrity pass. The generated receipt binds six local source/metadata hashes. Git-free optimized replay and exported receipt/source corruption controls also pass.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Fixed dense pairing, exact Gram target, root-code factors, all signed edges and 2 invertible are essential hypotheses. The predecessor lemmas are cited premises, not audit deliverables. Physical frames/access/restoration, hosting, precision, compiler and a complete recursive supplier remain outside the result. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No native, Lean, Docker, historical full replay, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Open next questions

- Which specified signed-edge deletion admits a strict exact root-code gain? Start with one n=4 mixed-axis configuration and a complete factorization with all literal support ranks. Its replacement tariff and physical consumer remain open.
- Can one shared sparse fitting pairing lower the coordinate bill at n=4,k=1? Enumerate compatible pairings and charge every term; deleting entries is not rank-monotone.

## Related open work

- #3045 studies sparse fitting pairings for full D4 and exceptional units. This proof fixes the dense pairing and adds an arbitrary retained-axis subset to the full signed-edge set.
- #2832 studies E8/P112 decoder reductions and outside-code factors. This result uses a different root set and keeps both factors inside its root code.
- #3120 studies the selected E8 centre-path demand floor. This obstruction does not change that unit or its selected charge.

The post-claim related-work refresh found no additional open PR addressing the same intermediate-axis Gram floor. Broader cached overlap covered 379 open PRs and 3,855 Discussion records, with incomplete sparse local notes; distinct all-main README/proof and merged-term searches supplement it. These searches do not certify novelty.
